settings.heading: I've tried probiotics. How is this different?
settings.content:
Probiotics add more bacteria. But if bad bacteria are hiding under a shield in your gut, adding more on top won't reach them.

Veltia goes after the shield. Garlic helps break it down,* so oregano, wormwood and black walnut can clear what's underneath.*

settings.heading: It worked for a while, then came back. Why would this be different?
settings.content:
That's the story we hear most.

Often it's because bad bacteria hide under a shield, wait out the treatment, then come back. Lab studies show garlic can help break that shield down,* which is why it comes first in our formula.

Veltia is a supplement, not medical care. If your symptoms are new, severe or getting worse, see your doctor.

settings.heading: My biggest problem is running to the bathroom after I eat. Will this help?
settings.content:
It's the most common reason people come to us.

When bad bacteria build up in your gut, food ferments fast. That can mean gas, cramps, bloating and a sudden need to go after meals. Veltia helps clear that buildup, for calmer, more predictable digestion.*

See your doctor first if you have blood in your stool, weight loss you can't explain, a fever, or you wake up at night to go.

settings.heading: How long should I take it?
settings.content:
At least 90 days, every day. It took time to build up, and it takes time to clear. That's why our guarantee lasts 90 days too.

Want to keep going after that? Ask your doctor.

settings.heading: Is there a guarantee?
settings.content: Yes. Take it every day for up to 90 days. If you don't feel a difference, email us and we'll refund your whole order.

settings.content:
One herb on its own has a hard time getting past the shield. And buying herbs separately means guessing how much to take.

Veltia puts all seven in one dropper, in set amounts. Garlic helps open the shield,* then the others clear what's underneath.*

settings.title: I used to know where every bathroom was.
settings.body: I couldn't even finish a meal without wondering if I'd need to run to the bathroom. Sometimes I'd barely make it home. The bloating and cramps were bad enough, but never knowing when it would hit was the worst part. After a few weeks with these drops, I started noticing more settled days. Being able to leave the house without planning my entire route around bathrooms felt like getting a piece of my life back.

settings.title: I went out to dinner without planning my escape.
settings.body: For the longest time, eating out felt like taking a gamble. I'd check where the bathrooms were before I even looked at the menu. Sometimes I'd skip meals just to avoid the risk. I didn't expect much when I started these drops, but over time I noticed more comfortable, predictable days. Last weekend, I went out to dinner and actually enjoyed the conversation instead of worrying about what my stomach might do.
settings.author: Rachel T., 42

settings.title: I was tired of wondering when it would hit.
settings.body: Probiotics, elimination diets, digestive enzymes. I'd tried so many things, and every time something seemed to help, the problems eventually came back. Some days I was fine. Other days I'd be running to the bathroom right after eating. The unpredictability was exhausting. What surprised me after starting these drops was having more days where my stomach wasn't constantly on my mind. I didn't realize how much mental energy I'd been spending worrying about it.
settings.author: Michelle D., 45

settings.title: I stopped saying no to everything.
settings.body: Nobody understood why I kept canceling plans. It wasn't that I didn't want to go. I was terrified of being somewhere without a bathroom nearby. The urgency, the cramping, the bloating afterward — I never knew what kind of day I was going to have. After spending some time with these drops, I began feeling more comfortable going about my routine. I recently took a weekend trip, and for once, my stomach wasn't the thing I worried about the entire time. That meant more to me than I can explain.

settings.question: Who should not take these drops?
settings.answer:
Talk to your doctor first if you:

  • are pregnant, nursing or trying to get pregnant
  • are under 18
  • take blood thinners or any prescription medicine
  • have seizures, or a liver, kidney or gallbladder condition
  • are allergic to ragweed or daisies (wormwood is in that plant family)

settings.question: How do I take it?
settings.answer:
Shake well.

Start with a few drops in a little water or juice, once a day.

Work up to one full dropper a day. Or follow the label.

settings.question: When should I see a doctor instead?
settings.answer:
See a doctor if your symptoms come with:

  • blood in your stool
  • weight loss you can't explain
  • fever, vomiting or bad pain
  • diarrhea that wakes you up at night
  • signs of dehydration, like dizziness or very dark urine
  • diarrhea that started after travel or after drinking untreated water (ask about a stool test)

These drops are for everyday gut support.*
